name: Old City of Berne
description: Bern's old city sits on a narrow hill almost encircled by a loop of the Aare River, and its medieval street plan from the 12th century is still intact. Strolling beneath miles of 15th-century arcades, past colourful 16th-century fountains and the towering minster, the tallest in Switzerland, you find a rebuilt sandstone town that still feels medieval. It also houses Switzerland's federal government.
